brief:
Israeli occupation forces killed three Palestinians on Saturday, including two who succumbed to wounds sustained in earlier attacks, IMEMC News reported. The deaths occurred as military operations involving invasions, shelling, and gunfire continued across Gaza. At least nine other people were wounded in the violence, among them children.

The report did not specify the locations where the killings took place or provide details of individual incidents. It noted that the operations were part of ongoing Israeli military activity in the territory, which has faced sustained bombardment and ground operations.
